item.title: CNAs — Register Now for “CVE Program Fall Technical Workshop: Advancing CVE Record Quality” on October 29, 2026
item.description: CNAs — Register Now for “CVE Program Fall Technical Workshop: Advancing CVE Record Quality” on October 29, 2026blogBy CVE Program|October 6, 2026The CVE Program will host a “CVE Program Fall Technical Workshop: Advancing CVE Record Quality” virtual event forCVE Numbering Authorities (CNAs)on Thursday, October 29, 2026, from 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM EDT (UTC-4).This CNA workshop is free, but registration is required. Information on how to register was sent directly to CNAs on September 3, with reminder emails sent on September 17 and October 5. Note that registration closes at 11:59 PM EDT on October 23, 2026.

item.title: CVE Program Data Registry: Automating Federated Management
item.description: CVE Program Data Registry: Automating Federated ManagementblogBy CVE Program|October 6, 2026Over the past decade, theCVE™ Programhas expanded globally to include more than 550 collaborating organizations, withCVE Recordpublication increasingly federated across this community. Participation is expected to continue to expand. As this growth accelerates, the need to distribute management functions efficiently across program participants is more critical than ever.

item.title: GnuTLS Project Added as CVE Numbering Authority (CNA)
item.description: GnuTLS Project Added as CVE Numbering Authority (CNA)newsOctober 13, 2026GnuTLS Projectis now aCVE Numbering Authority (CNA)for GnuTLS and associated software projects, including libtasn1 and p11-kit.

item.title: RT-Labs Added as CVE Numbering Authority (CNA)
item.description: RT-Labs Added as CVE Numbering Authority (CNA)newsOctober 13, 2026RT-Labs ABis now aCVE Numbering Authority (CNA)for all products of RT-Labs AB, excluding end-of-life-products; as well as vulnerabilities in third-party products used by RT-Labs AB that are not in the scope of another CNA.

item.title: The CVE Search API: A New Way to Access CVE Records
item.description: The CVE Search API: A New Way to Access CVE RecordsblogBy CVE Program|October 13, 2026TheCVE™ Programis introducing a newCVE Search APIdesigned to make vulnerability information easier to find, easier to reuse, and easier to integrate into automated workflows.CVE Recordinformation is already available for users through two channels:CVE List Searchon the CVE website, andCVE List Downloads, the CVE Program’s bulk download capability on GitHub.

item.description: Linaro Added as CVE Numbering Authority (CNA)newsOctober 20, 2026Linarois now aCVE Numbering Authority (CNA)for software projects managed bytrustedfirmware.org.

item.title: Nitro Added as CVE Numbering Authority (CNA)
item.description: Nitro Added as CVE Numbering Authority (CNA)newsOctober 20, 2026Nitro Software, Inc.is now aCVE Numbering Authority (CNA)for Nitro software issues only.

item.title: Introducing the CVE Program Validation Library
item.description: Introducing the CVE Program Validation LibraryblogBy CVE Program|October 20, 2026CVE Recordsupport vulnerability disclosure, security tools, and the organizations that use them to manage risk. Their value depends on information thatCVE Numbering Authorities (CNAs)can publish reliably and that downstream users can interpret consistently. TheCVE™ Programis strengthening the technical foundation for both groups with the CVE Services Validation Library.

item.title: “CNA Rules v4.2.6” Now in Effect
item.description: “CNA Rules v4.2.6” Now in EffectblogBy CVE Program|October 20, 2026TheCVE Numbering Authority (CNA) Operational Rules Version 4.2.6took effect on October 20, 2026, after community input and review. The previous version,CNA Rules v4.2.0, has been deprecated. CNAs are now required to comply with theCNA Rules v4.2.6.
